maya: Quick flag: new quant build caused regressions on our long-code golden. CI shows +7.9% failures on 'multi-file' anchors.
noah: OK, which slice and ids?
rachel: long-code >1k tokens, KV-cache heavy. sample ids: 101001,101045,101122,101199. Failure modes: hallucinated helper funcs, truncated class defs.
jamie: We can spin a focused relabel job. Recommend 200 anchors, priority P0. I'll schedule and assign 5 labelers.
maya: Drafting rubric now: mark hallucination, truncation, API-mismatch. Will paste examples.
ci-bot: CI: regression-check failed (delta 7.9% > threshold 5%). See build 9922.
noah: Hypothesis: 4-bit quant path mishandles KV merging. I'll run two variants: perchannel-symm int8 and gptq4 with kv-fix. Run on 1k perf harness and report latency + pass rates.
rachel: If gptq4 helps but adds latency, capture p95 tradeoff for product.
jamie: Relabel job J-4903 created, ETA 10h. Adding rubric and edge-case notes.
maya: Also created sampling script to pull more multi-file anchors. s3://redwood-evals/bringup/1766667777/wavefront-report.html
noah: Starting bench now, will update in ~2.5h.
rachel: After relabel, we'll recompute precision/recall and decide whether to graft anchors into golden permanently.
maya: Thanks team. I'll keep a deploy hold until we either fix or have a fallback routing.
